name: opencode
description: Use an OpenCode Go subscription as Claude Code's cheap executor. Claude conducts — requirements, architecture, the hard 20%, verification, review — and routes deterministic, high-volume work (scaffolding, implementation against a spec, test generation, migrations, first-pass review) to OpenCode's curated open-source coding models via the headless `opencode run` CLI. Hybrid agentic engineering with cost-aware 3-tier model routing.

default_tier.title: Default OpenCode Go tier
default_tier.description: Tier used by oc-delegate when --tier is not passed. One of: flash (deepseek-v4-flash, default — bulk work, ~158k req/mo), code (kimi-k2.7-code — implementation), pro (glm-5.2 — hard reasoning/review, scarce ~4.3k req/mo).

timeout.title: Default delegation timeout
timeout.description: Default wall-clock timeout for oc-delegate when --timeout is not passed, e.g. 10m, 300s.

coding_policy.title: Inject routing policy at session start
coding_policy.description: When on, a SessionStart hook injects this plugin's cost-aware routing policy (delegate above the break-even, keep Claude's context lean, always verify opencode's output) as session context. Set to off/false/0/no to suppress.

default_model.title: Default executor model (provider/model)
default_model.description: Exact model in opencode's provider/model format (see `opencode models`) used when --tier/--model are not passed. Leave empty to use the tier mapping. Keep the executor a different, cheaper model than the Claude conductor.

tier_flash.title: Model for the 'flash' tier
tier_flash.description: Override the model the 'flash' tier maps to (default: opencode-go/deepseek-v4-flash). Use provider/model from `opencode models`.

tier_code.title: Model for the 'code' tier
tier_code.description: Override the model the 'code' tier maps to (default: opencode-go/kimi-k2.7-code). Use provider/model from `opencode models`.

tier_pro.title: Model for the 'pro' tier
tier_pro.description: Override the model the 'pro' tier maps to (default: opencode-go/glm-5.2). Use provider/model from `opencode models`.

digest_warn_chars.title: Digest-size warning threshold (chars)
digest_warn_chars.description: oc-delegate warns on stderr when a reply exceeds this many characters — a raw dump instead of the digest the cost discipline calls for. Empty = 8000. Set 0 to disable.

delegation_nudge.title: Nudge delegation on bulk-looking prompts
delegation_nudge.description: When on, a UserPromptSubmit hook adds a short advisory note to Claude's context when a prompt looks like bulk work above the delegation break-even. Set to off/false/0/no to suppress.
